dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0030 handles medical treatment category point aggregation for insurance receipts.
evidence: fixed format, no EXEC CICS/SQL, COPY count 59, CALL count 60 consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - ORCA (JMA standard receipt software). This program aggregates treatment category point scores (診療区分別点数集計) for insurance claim forms.
purpose.summary: ORCR0030 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that computes and edits point-score columns broken down by medical treatment category for Japanese health insurance claim forms (レセプト). It processes patient visit data, applies various insurance rules, and populates receipt output records with aggregated point totals and counts. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2000-2006 covering numerous insurance system revisions.

notable_features: Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
59 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
1114 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (flat-file/indexed file based)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Long revision history with named developers (MCC, NACL teams)
verdict.notes: File is 1.5MB, 32099 lines - only first 16000 chars shown but clearly a large production program. Japanese comments are EUC-JP encoded but decoded as latin-1, appearing as mojibake. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. No COMP-3 is unusual for financial data but consistent with ORCA's coding style.
